evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. The /pull endpoint returns a different HTTP status (503 vs 500) and structured error body when HF is throttled — clients typically retry on both, and the new format adds useful retry metadata. The RegistryRateLimitError C++ exception class is internal. The test helper gained an optional rate_limit_budget parameter with a default, preserving backward compatibility.
evidence.documentation: The PR states no documentation changes are needed, which is appropriate for an internal CI fix and improved error handling. The API docs were not altered.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The LEMONADE_CI_MODE change (auto_check_model_updates=false) is CI-only. The /pull endpoint now returns 503 with Retry-After and code=registry_unavailable instead of 500 when HF is rate-limited — this is an external-condition behavior change (requires HF throttling) and is a strict improvement over the prior 500 response. The SSE stream_download_operation path similarly gains the structured error. No manual test is practical or necessary.
evidence.post_approval_commits: The PR branch had two merges with main (2026-10-15 and 2026-10-18) and one rebase commit removing the cache fallback. @fl0rianr approved after the removal on 2026-10-18T10:36:53Z; @superm1 approved on 2026-10-19T18:05:31Z; the final merge with main (0ca75c6) occurred at 2026-10-20T03:41:37Z. All post-approval commits were merge commits — no new behavior was added after the latest approval.
evidence.review: PR #3859 was requested for review by @jeremyfowers. @fl0rianr reviewed first (CI subject-area expert), requested changes on a proposed cache-fallback feature, then approved after the author removed it. @superm1 also approved. CodeRabbit bot raised 4 issues across the cache fallback and test helper; the author resolved all by removing the cache fallback and fixing the retry logic. No substantive post-approval commits altered the review scope.
evidence.security: No security concerns. No new supply-chain dependencies, credential handling changes, or code execution paths. The change reduces external API calls in CI (auto_check_model_updates=false), which actually improves the security posture slightly.
evidence.tests: The test helper in test/utils/server_base.py was modified to parse structured error codes instead of string-matching repo IDs, and to handle 503 with a bounded 60s retry budget. This improves CI robustness but no new unit or integration test was added to verify the new RegistryRateLimitError exception or the 503 response path on the C++ server side. No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

subject: fix(ci): stop Hugging Face rate limits from failing model pulls (#3859)
summary: Stops Hugging Face rate limits from failing model pulls by disabling per-repo startup update checks in LEMONADE_CI_MODE and returning 503 with Retry-After headers (code: "registry_unavailable") instead of 500 when the HF registry is throttled, plus extending the test helper's /pull retry budget from ~6s to 60s.
verdict_reason: Well-scoped CI fix that properly addresses rate-limiting with no breaking changes, adequate review, and no user-facing behavior requiring manual release testing.
